description:
Operating Area: Kimberley (Western Australia), Australia

The Kimberley Quest II has been designed for relaxing and exploring the Kimberley coastline in complete comfort and style. Our custom-built vessel is fully air-conditioned, equipped with a helipad, spa and large ensuited cabins. The vessel has comfortable indoor and spacious al fresco areas so there is plenty of room to take in the panoramic scenery and breath-taking sunsets. Accommodating just 18 guests and 6 crew, your holiday of a lifetime can be enjoyed with fellow travellers in luxurious and intimate surrounds.

crew.name: Bryne Tuckey
crew.bio:
What is your role with Kimberley Quest?
Captain

How would you describe yourself?
Love adventure, fair and easygoing.

Describe your role in 10 words or less:
Creating an itinerary that caters to everyone.

What is your favourite aspect of your job?
The constant amazing views the Kimberley provides and showcasing everything to our guests.

Your favourite activity and why?
I don't think I can pick! I love a scenic cruise on KQII, our Jetboat or going out on the tenders!.

What is your favourite icon in the Kimberley?
Horizontal Falls.

Your favourite time of the year and why?
April - May, post wet season, as the heat and humidity start to lower with some perfect weather days!

Your favourite meal on board?
Haha Can I say anything, as I am a bad cook and I can't pass up a fresh fish dinner!

What are your favourite hobbies to do when you are on your time off?
Boating (can't keep me off them) fishing, camping 4wd driving - anything outdoors related.

crew.name: Alex Tom
crew.bio:
What is your role with Kimberley Quest?
Captain

How would you describe yourself?
Adventurous, easygoing.

Describe your role in 10 words or less:
Giving people their dream adventure holiday of a life time.

What is your favourite aspect of your job?
Getting to know everyone from all over Australia & seeing the Kimberley from a whole new perspective.

Your favourite activity and why?
Exploring new places because we may be the first there and fishing for Barramundi.

What is your favourite icon in the Kimberley?
King George.

Your favourite time of the year and why?
April because we go to the north.

Your favourite meal on board?
Pumpkin Pie & Steak night.

What are your favourite hobbies to do when you are on your time off?
Camping & 4wding.

crew.name: Siddharth Murthy (Sid)
crew.bio:
What is your role with Kimberley Quest?
Chef

How would you describe yourself?
Friendly, curious for new experiences, adventurous to try new things, a peoples person, community focused, keen to discover new food, knowledge, places, people, history, culture.

Describe your role in 10 words or less:
My role is to provide Kimberley Quest guests with the best culinary experience onboard that I can provide, with quality ingredients and local produce. Also exploring new tastes and flavours and the freshest seafood we can catch on a our travels across the Kimberley coast.

What is your favourite aspect of your job?
Guest interaction, guest satisfaction, working with a diverse and fun crew, exploring the Kimberley by sea and working with amazing produce from the Kimberley coastline.

Your favourite activity and why?
Starting the day watching a beautiful sunrise over the Kimberley coast. It's a sort of reset and recharge for the day ahead.

What is your favourite icon in the Kimberley?
Mitchell Falls.

Your favourite time of the year and why?
Winters in the Kimberley are amazing. Warm sunny days and cool nights.

Your favourite meal on board?
Breakfast is my favourite meal.

What are your favourite hobbies to do when you are on your time off?
I like to volunteer with local communities. Mainly focusing on my skills of cooking and growing food.

crew.name: Naomi (Nomes) Lang
crew.bio:
What is your role with Kimberley Quest?
Hostess

How would you describe yourself?
Bubbly and smiley.

Describe your role in 10 words or less:
Cleaning fairy

What is your favourite aspect of your job?
Experiencing the Kimberley day in and day out and meeting so many interesting people.

Your favourite activity and why?
Silica Beach sunsets are something else, white sand, orange sandstone with a Kimberley sunset!

What is your favourite icon in the Kimberley?
Montgomery Reef on a king tide or Leadline Creek with towering gorge walls.

Your favourite time of the year and why?
Dry season (July and August) cool mornings and bliss days!

Your favourite meal on board?
Lamb ribs with puree!

What are your favourite hobbies to do when you are on your time off?
Yoga, photography, camping and reading a good book!

crew.name: Amber Dee
crew.bio:
What is your role with Kimberley Quest?
Hostess

How would you describe yourself?
Positive, motivated, fun, outgoing, always happy to help

Describe your role in 10 words or less:
Smiles, service, and making every guest feel VIP

What is your favourite aspect of your job?
Meeting new guests from all over the world, hearing their stories and ensuring their holiday is unforgettable

Your favourite activity and why?
Going to new beaches, finding cool shells and whale watching

What is your favourite icon in the Kimberley?
Has to be Montgomery reef. Clear blue waters and hundreds of turtles 

Your favourite time of the year and why?
Winter, beautiful weather, clear sky, gorgeous sunrise and sunsets. Every reason why I left the UK. Just chasing the sun

Your favourite meal on board?
Poke bowls

What are your favourite hobbies to do when you are on your time off?
CAMPING! Sunbathing, morning walks along the beach

crew.name: Jackson McReady
crew.bio:
What is your role with Kimberley Quest?
Deckhand / Expedition Guide

How would you describe yourself?
Adventurous, curious & passionate!

Describe your role in 10 words or less:
Helping deliver the experience of a lifetime!

What is your favourite aspect of your job?
Researching and exploring new places with our amazing guests.

Your favourite activity and why?
The next one! Amazing experiences round every corner, but catching a nice Barra or Mackerel is always a good challenge!

What is your favourite icon in the Kimberley?
Experiencing the best sunrise in the world from the incredible Hunter River.

Your favourite time of the year and why?
March - April, incredible waterfalls, lush flora and cool weather.

Your favourite meal on board?
The fresh catch of the day.

What are your favourite hobbies to do when you are on your time off?
Travel the world -  Carry on luggage - a one-way ticket - and to go with the flow!

crew.name: Charles (Charlie) Webb
crew.bio:
What is your role with Kimberley Quest?
Deckhand / Expedition Guide

How would you describe yourself?
Outgoing, keen to learn, and always ready for dinner!

Describe your role in 10 words or less:
A perfect way to explore & share the Kimberley coast.

What is your favourite aspect of your job?
Sharing information with people about unique areas... and dinner time!

Your favourite activity and why?
Montgomery Reef in every aspect - tender - helicopter or experiencing the Sand Cay!

What is your favourite icon in the Kimberley?
Tim Willing.

Your favourite time of the year and why?
Off the back of the wet season, when catchments are full and waterfalls are in full flow.

Your favourite meal on board?
All of them!

What are your favourite hobbies to do when you are on your time off?
Camping, drone photography, and amateur bird watching.

crew.name: Liam Reilly
crew.bio:
What is your role with Kimberley Quest?
Deckhand / Expedition Guide

How would you describe yourself?
Fun loving individual addicted to the ocean and everything around it!

Describe your role in 10 words or less:
Assisting with manning the vessel and daily operations.

What is your favourite aspect of your job?
Meeting new guests and getting to take them on a once and a life time experience is my favourite aspect of my job.

Your favourite activity and why?
Fishing is my favourite activity, taking people out to catch the biggest fish or first fish and watching the look on their faces makes my day.

What is your favourite icon in the Kimberley?
My favourite icon in the Kimberly’s has to be Montgomery reef, with all the sea life you get to witness out there.

Your favourite time of the year and why?
Winter in the Kimberley has to be my favourite, with stella weather and a great climate!

Your favourite meal on board?
My favourite meal on board has to be raw fish we do as canapés, you can’t beat fresh raw fish! 

What are your favourite hobbies to do when you are on your time off?
My favourite hobbies to do on my time off are camping, 4-Wheel-Driving and fishing!
